title: Automating IAM Credential Auditing Across AWS Organizations with IAM Access Analyzer
description: Learn how to detect unused access keys, enforce least-privilege boundary policies, and remediate over-permissive role trust policies across enterprise multi-account landing zones.

title: Amazon GuardDuty Expands Threat Detection Coverage for Container Workloads in Amazon EKS
description: GuardDuty now features kernel-level monitoring for unauthorized privilege escalation, cryptocurrency mining activity, and unexpected outbound network connections inside EKS pods.

title: Designing Zero-Trust Network Perimeters with AWS Transit Gateway and VPC Lattice
description: Examine reference architectures for replacing legacy internet-facing reverse proxies with private service-to-service mTLS mesh communication, eliminating public IP exposures.
